digest.component_or_area: link graph / library writes / MCP interface
propositions: add_dependency escalates cross-subtree blocking links to common ancestor children but returns the record only via stdout, invisible to library and MCP callers
rebar.link and _python_leaf and _link drop the redirect record return value on the floor, so library callers receive no indication that different endpoints were recorded than requested
link_tickets MCP tool returns literal 'ok' regardless of escalation, leaving agents unaware that a substitution occurred
quiet=True stdout/stderr redirection suppresses both the redirect record and warnings, and cannot be removed without corrupting the MCP JSON-RPC stdio stream
the return value must propagate through five layers (add_dependency → link_core → _link → _python_leaf → rebar.link) to reach callers, with three currently silently discarding it
